text: Selection: ABUNGST-L and FYODOR-L are the Frothly endpoints to submit because the complete Sysmon EventCode=3 result set for DestinationIp 45.77.53.176 names exactly those two hosts and no others; any unresolved non-endpoint or unmonitored asset such as 192.168.9.30 does not displace them for the question's 'at least two endpoints' wording.
